2607.14735.title: CoTu at EXACT 2026: Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Transparent Educational QA
2607.14735.paper_summary: Transparent educational question answering asks for answers that are not only correct but explainable, and doing so with small models rules out the reasoning power of the largest proprietary systems. The EXACT 2026 competition poses this problem concretely: open-weight language models of at most 8B parameters, self-hosted, with a natural-language explanation for every answer. It pairs two tasks: logical reasoning over university regulations, and multi-step physics problem solving. We describe the system that team \cotu{} developed to address both, a neuro-symbolic Program-of-Thought pipeline in which a 4B backbone writes a program rather than stating an answer directly: for regulation queries it emits a Z3 encoding whose entailment verdict grounds the deduction, and for physics it emits numerical Python, both wrapped in a shared self-correction loop and a unified explained-JSON output. Answer-type routing, distillation-based task fine-tuning, and a latency-aware serving stack -- SGLang with speculative decoding -- keep the system within the 60-second per-query limit. The system achieved a \textbf{perfect score} on the physics task in both automated selection rounds and obtained the \textbf{highest final-round technical score} of any team -- $13.44/15$, combining automated answer evaluation with expert-judged reasoning depth -- with the equally weighted presentation score included, \cotu{} placed 3rd overall. Grounding answers in a symbolic solver yields correct, verifiable deductions at the 4B scale, and the residual difficulty lies in premise selection rather than the deduction itself.
2607.14735.paper_summary_zh: 透明的教育問題回答要求答案不僅正確，還必須可解釋，而使用小型模型則排除了最大專有系統的推理能力。EXACT 2026 競賽具體提出了這個問題：最多 8B 參數的開放權重語言模型，自我托管，並為每個答案提供自然語言解釋。它結合了兩個任務：對大學規章的邏輯推理，以及多步物理問題的解決。我們描述了團隊 \cotu{} 開發的系統，以解決這兩個任務，這是一個神經符號的思維程序管道，其中一個 4B 的主幹編寫程序，而不是直接給出答案：對於規章查詢，它發出一個 Z3 編碼，其推理裁決為推導提供基礎；對於物理問題，它發出數值 Python，兩者都包裹在共享的自我修正循環和統一的解釋 JSON 輸出中。答案類型路由、基於蒸餾的任務微調和延遲感知的服務堆棧——SGLang 與推測解碼——使系統保持在每個查詢 60 秒的限制內。該系統在物理任務的自動選擇回合中獲得了 \textbf{完美分數}，並獲得了任何團隊的 \textbf{最高最終回合技術分數}——$13.44/15$，結合自動答案評估與專家評判的推理深度——包括相等權重的演示分數，\cotu{} 總體排名第三。將答案基於符號求解器可以在 4B 的規模上產生正確、可驗證的推導，而剩餘的困難在於前提選擇，而不是推導本身。
